seal.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: photorealistic film prop reference sheet for the Chinese historical interactive game 逆转五丈原.
Create ONE high-resolution landscape reference sheet depicting the SAME small late Eastern Han style personal bronze seal from four angles. This is an original fictional prop belonging to Pang Tong, not an excavated artifact. Clean warm light gray neutral studio background, no lettering, no page titles, no labels, no decorative framing.
Object design: a modest palm-sized square bronze seal approximately 22mm square, low thick square base, plain low arched bridge/nose knob with a real transverse hole. Dark warm brown used bronze, subtly polished brass-colored high points, very little subtle dark patina in crevices; still in use in its own era, NOT an archaeological lump of bright green corrosion. One distinctive small chipped corner on the base, consistently positioned in every angle. A short faded dark reddish-brown woven silk cord passes through the knob, tied with a simple knot, slightly frayed ends, no large tassel. Restrained utilitarian craftsmanship, not ornate luxury.
Composition: large left half hero macro three-quarter view shows the base and perforated knob clearly, cord lying on the surface; top right top-down view; center-right eye-level side view; lower-right close view of the engraved underside placed beside one brown clay seal impression. Same geometry, material and same chipped corner in ALL views. Show the engraved underside with exactly the traditional name 龐統 in period-inspired two-character seal script, 龐 on the right and 統 on the left; the engraving is physically reversed for stamping, clay impression reads in correct orientation. No modern simplified Chinese on the object. Realistic incised seal carving, not laser engraving, not modern printed font. The clay impression is moist brown clay, NOT red ink on white paper.
Soft controlled studio light, extremely clear fine material texture, physically plausible scale. No dragons, no phoenix sculpture, no imperial jade seal, no gemstones, no modern objects, no hands, no watermarks.
seal.historicalBasis: Fictional personal seal using Han-style bronze square base and pierced low knob, not a reconstruction of an attested Pang Tong artifact.

character.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / historical-scene. Asset type: photorealistic character identity and costume reference sheet for subsequent film/video generation.
INPUT IMAGE 1 is an identity/costume reference. Use ONLY the man on the RIGHT half of the provided screenshot as Pang Tong's established screen appearance. Ignore the man on the left completely and ignore all subtitles and background furniture. Preserve the right-hand man's exact recognizable face identity and proportions: mature East Asian man, narrow long face, high slightly receding forehead, defined cheekbones, thin angular eyebrows with a habitual slight knitted brow, deep-set dark eyes, straight narrow nose, thin slightly downturned lips, thin moustache and narrow pointed dark goatee. Do not beautify, do not make younger, do not substitute a generic handsome strategist, do not change beard style. Maintain realistic skin pores and age lines.
Preserve his very distinctive tall dark near-black cloth crown: high open cylindrical/tapered cage-like crown with repeated narrow raised ribs and crossed diagonal strips in the upper part, a solid broad dark band at the forehead, long black hair gathered back with dark fabric trailing behind. Preserve the exact deep indigo/navy robe seen on the right: subtle repeating woven angular/quilted geometric pattern, broad crossed lapels with narrow muted reddish-brown piping, undyed gray-beige inner cross-collar, modest belt, loose long sleeves. No armor, no feather fan, no crown redesign.
Create ONE coherent high-resolution landscape 3-column by 2-row character reference sheet on a continuous clean pale warm gray studio background. Six separate views with generous margins and no overlap:
top row: front face and shoulders, left-facing true profile face and shoulders, right-facing three-quarter face and shoulders.
bottom row: straight-on standing full body including crown and cloth shoes, standing back full body showing hair and crown construction, matching three-quarter waist-up portrait with both hands naturally visible at rest.
All SIX are the exact SAME person and outfit, with consistent crown height and beard, same age, neutral thoughtful expression, stable proportions. Use screenshot-faithful film realism, natural skin and cloth, neutral balanced studio illumination that reveals the navy fabric without changing its color. No dream effects, no fog, no glows, no other people, no inscriptions, no text, no subtitles, no grid lines, no watermarks. Extend the unseen lower half conservatively with a plain ankle-length navy scholar robe and simple dark cloth shoes.
character.scope: Reference-derived views; unseen sides and lower costume are generated extrapolations.
